sets.title: Set A — Urban Energy & Public Libraries

task1.title: Task 1
task1.instruction:
The chart below shows the average daily electricity consumption (in kilowatt-hours) of four types of buildings in a mid-sized city in 2015 and 2025.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

task2.title: Task 2
task2.instruction:
Some people believe that public libraries are no longer necessary because digital technology provides easy access to information.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

sets.title: Set B — Tourism Seasons & Remote Work

task1.title: Task 1
task1.instruction:
The table below shows the number of international visitors (in thousands) to three coastal regions of a country in the peak season and the off season of 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

task2.title: Task 2
task2.instruction:
An increasing number of employees are choosing to work from home rather than commute to an office.

Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

sets.title: Set C — Recycling Process & Youth Sports

task1.title: Task 1
task1.instruction:
The diagram below shows the process of recycling plastic bottles into new products.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
process_steps: Collection of used plastic bottles from households and public bins
Sorting by colour and polymer type at a recycling centre
Washing and shredding into plastic flakes
Manufacturing new products (e.g. containers, textiles, packaging)
Distribution of finished goods to retailers

task2.title: Task 2
task2.instruction:
Many schools are reducing the amount of time spent on physical education in order to focus more on academic subjects.

What are the causes of this trend, and what effects might it have on young people?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
